description: A saturation run of length \(k\) is a sequence of exactly \(k\) steps, each adding one missing resolvent; a run of length zero leaves its clause set unchanged.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.SaturationRun.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] :
  ℕ → Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α → Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α → Prop
